types.name: orders.v1.AttachedRisk
types.doc:
AttachedRisk is the single parent-side view for attached-risk configuration
 and runtime status.

fields.name: take_profit
fields.doc: Take-profit leg, if configured or if state exists.

fields.name: stop_loss
fields.doc: Stop-loss leg, if configured or if state exists.

fields.name: trailing_stop
fields.doc: Trailing-stop leg, if configured or if state exists.

fields.name: oco
fields.doc: True when the take-profit and stop leg are linked as one-cancels-the-other.

types.name: orders.v1.AttachedRiskLegState
types.doc: AttachedRiskLegState provides runtime linkage/state for one attached-risk leg.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current runtime lifecycle status for this attached-risk leg.

fields.name: armed_ts_ns
fields.doc: Time the leg was armed, in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC). Zero if not armed.

fields.name: terminal_ts_ns
fields.doc: Time the leg reached a terminal state, in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC). Zero if not terminal.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger identifier for this attached-risk leg.

fields.name: child_order_id
fields.doc: Child order ID created by this leg after it fires.

types.name: orders.v1.AttachedRiskStopLoss
types.doc: AttachedRiskStopLoss carries both stop-loss config and runtime state.

fields.name: policy
fields.doc: Stop-loss policy configured on the parent order.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Runtime state for the stop-loss leg.

types.name: orders.v1.AttachedRiskTakeProfit
types.doc: AttachedRiskTakeProfit carries both take-profit config and runtime state.

fields.name: policy
fields.doc: Take-profit policy configured on the parent order.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Runtime state for the take-profit leg.

types.name: orders.v1.AttachedRiskTrailingStop
types.doc: AttachedRiskTrailingStop carries both trailing-stop config and runtime state.

fields.name: policy
fields.doc: Trailing-stop policy configured on the parent order.

fields.name: state
fields.doc: Runtime state for the trailing-stop leg.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCancelItem
types.doc: BatchCancelItem identifies a single order to cancel within a batch.

cel.message: exactly one of order_id or client_order_id must be set

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64. Exactly one of order_id or client_order_id.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID. Exactly one of order_id or client_order_id.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional symbol routing hint.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCancelOrdersRequest
types.doc: BatchCancelOrdersRequest cancels multiple orders by explicit ID.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Idempotency key (required).

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Orders to cancel (max 50).

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCancelOrdersResponse
types.doc: BatchCancelOrdersResponse returns per-item results for a batch cancel.

fields.name: results
fields.doc: Per-item results in same order as request.

fields.name: accepted_count
fields.doc: Aggregate counts.

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCancelResultItem
types.doc: BatchCancelResultItem contains the per-item result of a batch cancel.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: "accepted" or "rejected".

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Resolved order ID (populated on accept).

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Echoed client order ID (when provided).

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Error code if rejected.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCreateOrdersRequest
types.doc: BatchCreateOrdersRequest places multiple orders in one request.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Top-level idempotency key for the batch request.

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Orders to create (max 20). Reuses CreateOrderRequest payload, including attached risk.

fields.name: allow_partial
fields.doc: Optional partial-success flag. Current implementation is always best-effort.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCreateOrdersResponse
types.doc: BatchCreateOrdersResponse returns per-item results for a batch create.

fields.name: results
fields.doc: Per-item results in same order as request.

fields.name: accepted_count
fields.doc: Aggregate counts.

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.BatchCreateResultItem
types.doc: BatchCreateResultItem contains the per-item result of a batch create.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: "accepted" or "rejected".

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Resolved order ID (populated on accept).

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Echoed client order ID.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Error code if rejected.

fields.name: take_profit_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached take-profit (when accepted and configured).

fields.name: stop_loss_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached stop-loss (when accepted and configured).

fields.name: trailing_stop_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached trailing stop (when accepted and configured).

types.name: orders.v1.BatchModifyItem
types.doc: BatchModifyItem identifies one modify operation inside a batch request.

cel.message: at least one patch field must be set

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64. Exactly one of order_id or client_order_id.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID. Exactly one of order_id or client_order_id.

fields.name: new_price_ticks
fields.doc: New limit price in ticks.

fields.name: new_qty_scaled
fields.doc: Target total quantity after modify/replace.

fields.name: new_attached_risk
fields.doc: Replacement attached-risk policy for the order.

fields.name: behavior
fields.doc:
Optional per-item behavior override.
 MODIFY_BEHAVIOR_UNSPECIFIED means "use behavior_default".

fields.name: new_client_order_id
fields.doc: Optional new client order id when replace path is taken.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchModifyOrdersRequest
types.doc: BatchModifyOrdersRequest updates multiple orders in one request.

cel.message: each item target must be unique within a batch

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Idempotency key (required).

fields.name: items
fields.doc: Modify items.

fields.name: behavior_default
fields.doc:
Default behavior for items with unspecified behavior.
 MODIFY_BEHAVIOR_UNSPECIFIED is treated as AMEND_OR_REPLACE.

fields.name: allow_partial
fields.doc: Optional partial-success flag. Current behavior is best-effort per item.

types.name: orders.v1.BatchModifyOrdersResponse
types.doc: BatchModifyOrdersResponse returns per-item modify outcomes.

fields.name: results
fields.doc: Per-item results in the same order as the request items.

fields.name: amended_count
fields.doc: Number of items amended in place.

fields.name: replaced_count
fields.doc: Number of items replaced with a new order.

fields.name: rejected_count
fields.doc: Number of items rejected.

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.BatchModifyResultItem
types.doc: BatchModifyResultItem contains one result in a batch modify response.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: "modified" or "rejected".

fields.name: action_taken
fields.doc: AMENDED or REPLACED when modified.

fields.name: old_order_id
fields.doc: Original order ID that was amended or replaced.

fields.name: final_order_id
fields.doc: Final active order ID; same as old_order_id for amendments.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID associated with the final order when available.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Error code if rejected.

fields.name: take_profit_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached take-profit after modification.

fields.name: stop_loss_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached stop-loss after modification.

fields.name: trailing_stop_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached trailing stop after modification.

types.name: orders.v1.CancelAllAfterRequest
types.doc: CancelAllAfterRequest arms/disables a dead-man switch for automatic cancel-all.

cel.message: timeout_sec must be 0 or between 10 and 120

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: timeout_sec
fields.doc:
Heartbeat timeout in seconds.
 - 0 disables the dead-man switch for this account.
 - 10..120 arms or refreshes the switch.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc:
Optional symbol filter. When set, only orders on this symbol are canceled
 on expiry. When empty, all symbols are canceled.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Optional side filter for cancel-on-expiry.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Idempotency/trace key from caller (required).

types.name: orders.v1.CancelAllAfterResponse
types.doc: CancelAllAfterResponse returns dead-man switch arming/disable status.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: "armed" or "disabled".

fields.name: effective_timeout_sec
fields.doc: Effective timeout in seconds (0 when disabled).

fields.name: expires_at_ts_ns
fields.doc: Expiry timestamp in epoch nanoseconds (0 when disabled).

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.CancelAllOrdersRequest
types.doc: CancelAllOrdersRequest cancels all matching open orders for an account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc:
Symbol filter. When set, only orders on this symbol are canceled.
 When empty, all symbols are canceled.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Side filter. When set, only orders on this side are canceled.

fields.name: dry_run
fields.doc: If true, return matched counts without actually canceling.

fields.name: max_orders
fields.doc:
Safety cap: reject if matched orders exceed this limit. Default 1000.
 Bounded to prevent accidental runaway values.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Idempotency key (required).

types.name: orders.v1.CancelAllOrdersResponse
types.doc: CancelAllOrdersResponse returns the result of a cancel-all operation.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: "submitted" or "dry_run".

fields.name: matched_orders
fields.doc: Number of orders that matched the filter.

fields.name: submitted_cancels
fields.doc: Number of cancel requests submitted for processing.

fields.name: failed_cancels
fields.doc: Number of cancels that could not be submitted (already canceled, etc.).

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.CancelOrderRequest
types.doc: CancelOrderRequest is the binary (protobuf) request for canceling orders.

cel.message: exactly one of order_id or client_order_id must be set

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional symbol_id for routing; when omitted, resolved from order directory.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

types.name: orders.v1.CancelOrderResponse
types.doc: CancelOrderResponse is the binary (protobuf) response after canceling an order.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Status indicator, e.g., "accepted".

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64.

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.CreateOrderRequest
types.doc:
CreateOrderRequest is the binary (protobuf) request for placing orders.
 Uses scaled integers for quantity and price, plus fixed64 IDs.
 Preferred by latency-sensitive clients.

cel.message: market_max_slippage/client reference are only valid for MARKET orders

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol
fields.doc: Trading pair symbol, e.g., "BTC-USDT"; resolved to pair_id by gateway.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Order side: BUY or SELL.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type: LIMIT or MARKET.

fields.name: tif
fields.doc: Time-in-force: GTC, IOC, or FOK. Defaults to GTC if unspecified.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc: Quantity in base asset scale units (scaled integer).

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Price in ticks (6 decimals); optional for MARKET orders.

fields.name: market_max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: market_max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: market_client_ref_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Optional client-side reference price in ticks for MARKET slippage anchoring.
 When absent, admission uses server-side reference pricing.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: If true, the order is rejected instead of crossing the book (maker-only).

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Optional client order identifier for idempotency.

fields.name: fee_source
fields.doc: Fee source for BUY orders: QUOTE (default) or RECEIVED.

fields.name: stp_mode
fields.doc: Self-trade prevention mode. Defaults to EXPIRE_MAKER if unspecified.

fields.name: attached_risk
fields.doc: Optional attached risk controls (TP/SL/TrailingStop) for this order.

types.name: orders.v1.CreateOrderResponse
types.doc: CreateOrderResponse is the binary (protobuf) response after placing an order.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Status indicator, e.g., "accepted".

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Echoed client order ID (when provided in request).

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

fields.name: take_profit_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached take-profit.

fields.name: stop_loss_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached stop-loss.

fields.name: trailing_stop_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger ID for attached trailing stop.

types.name: orders.v1.ErrorCode
types.doc:
ErrorCode enumerates stable machine-readable error codes for the Orders API.
 These mirror the REST problem+json "code" field for parity between REST and
 ConnectRPC clients.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_BAD_REQUEST
values.doc: Request could not be parsed or was structurally invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INVALID_ARGUMENT
values.doc: Request fields failed validation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_INSUFFICIENT_FUNDS
values.doc: Account does not have enough available balance for the order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNKNOWN_SYMBOL
values.doc: Requested trading symbol is unknown.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_BAD_PRICE
values.doc: Price is invalid for the requested order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_BAD_QTY
values.doc: Quantity is invalid for the requested order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MIN_NOTIONAL
values.doc: Order notional is below the pair minimum.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_QTY_STEP_SIZE
values.doc: Quantity does not align with the pair step size.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_ORDER_ID
values.doc: Client order ID is already in use for a different active order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: Service is temporarily unavailable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UNAUTHENTICATED
values.doc: Caller is not authenticated.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PERMISSION_DENIED
values.doc: Caller is authenticated but not allowed to perform this action.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: Requested order or resource was not found.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_UPSTREAM_ERROR
values.doc: Upstream dependency returned an error.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FEE_SOURCE_NOT_ALLOWED
values.doc: Requested fee source is not allowed for this order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_DISABLED
values.doc: Additional domain-specific codes used by the Orders API.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_SUBACCOUNT_INACTIVE
values.doc:
Sub-account is present but not in an active state (disabled, deleted,
 etc.).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_MARKET_DENY
values.doc: Sub-account policy prevented trading on this market (e.g. pair mask).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_MAX_NOTIONAL
values.doc: Sub-account policy max order notional exceeded.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_TRADING_HALTED
values.doc: Trading has been globally halted for this sub-account.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POLICY_SPOT_TRADE_DENY
values.doc: Sub-account policy does not allow spot trading (action mask).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_ROOT_SCOPE_ONLY
values.doc:
API key is scoped to the master/root account and cannot trade on
 sub-accounts.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_SUB_SCOPE_ONLY
values.doc:
API key is scoped to a specific sub-account and cannot trade on the
 master/root account.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_SUBACCOUNT_MISMATCH
values.doc: API key is scoped to a different sub-account than the one requested.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_POLICY_REQUIRED
values.doc: API key must have an attached policy before it can be used for trading.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_UNKNOWN
values.doc:
API key referenced in the request could not be resolved by the Orders
 service.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_API_KEY_MARKET_DENY
values.doc:
API key policy does not allow trading this market, even though the
 sub-account policy does.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PRICE_TICK_SIZE
values.doc: Price must align with the pair tick size (LIMIT orders).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MIN_QTY
values.doc: Quantity is below the pair minimum quantity (base units).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POST_ONLY_LIMIT_ONLY
values.doc: Post-only is only valid for LIMIT orders.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_BATCH_TOO_LARGE
values.doc: Batch size exceeds the maximum allowed.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED
values.doc: Cancel-all matched more orders than the safety cap allows.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MODIFICATION_REQUIRES_REPLACE
values.doc: Modify request in AMEND_ONLY mode requires replace semantics.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSE
values.doc: Idempotency key was reused with a different payload.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MARKET_PRICE_UNAVAILABLE
values.doc: MARKET BUY cannot be reserved because no reference/top-of-book price is available.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_NOT_LISTED_YET
values.doc: Pair exists but is not listed yet.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_DELISTED
values.doc: Pair was delisted and is no longer tradable.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_CANCEL_ONLY
values.doc: Pair is in cancel-only mode.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_POST_ONLY
values.doc: Pair is in post-only mode and requires post_only=true.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PAIR_REDUCE_ONLY
values.doc: Pair is in reduce-only mode and does not accept new spot orders.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_RISK_LIMIT
values.doc: Account-level risk limits were exceeded.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MARKET_HALTED
values.doc: Market is halted.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ACCOUNT_UNKNOWN
values.doc: Referenced account could not be resolved by the trading service.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_POST_ONLY_CROSS
values.doc: Post-only order would cross the book.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_REDUCE_ONLY_BLOCKED
values.doc: Reduce-only policy blocked the order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_PRICE_BAND_VIOLATION
values.doc: Price band guard rejected the order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MARKET_CAP_VIOLATION
values.doc: Market-cap guard rejected the order.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_EMPTY_BOOK
values.doc: Market order could not execute due to empty book.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_FOK_INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY
values.doc: FOK order rejected due to insufficient immediate liquidity.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_ORDER_ALREADY_TERMINAL
values.doc: Client order ID points to an order that already reached terminal state.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_PRICE_INVALID
values.doc:
Trigger-specific error codes (40-49 range).
 Trigger price is invalid (e.g., TP below current price for long).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_PRICE_SOURCE_UNSUPPORTED
values.doc:
Trigger price source not supported (e.g., INDEX_PRICE before it's
 available).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRAILING_DISTANCE_INVALID
values.doc: Trailing stop distance must be positive.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_NOT_FOUND
values.doc: Trigger not found (for cancel/get operations).

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_CANCEL_REJECTED
values.doc: Trigger cannot be canceled in current state.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_STATUS_INVALID
values.doc: Trigger status does not allow requested lifecycle operation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_TRIGGER_NOT_MODIFIABLE
values.doc: Trigger type/state does not support requested lifecycle operation.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_CLIENT_TRIGGER_ID
values.doc: Duplicate client trigger ID was reused with a different trigger payload.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_MAX_SLIPPAGE_INVALID
values.doc: Trailing-stop max slippage (ticks or bps) is invalid.

values.name: ERROR_CODE_STALE_QUOTE
values.doc: Client reference price is stale compared to server-side BBO/drift policy.

types.name: orders.v1.ErrorDetail
types.doc:
ErrorDetail is attached to ConnectRPC errors for structured error handling.
 Clients can inspect this to get a stable machine-readable error code.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Stable error code matching the REST problem+json "code" field.

values.name: QUOTE
values.doc: Fees are paid from quote asset.

values.name: RECEIVED
values.doc: Fees are paid from the received asset.

types.name: orders.v1.GetOpenOrdersRequest
types.doc: GetOpenOrdersRequest lists currently non-terminal orders for an account.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional filter by symbol_id values. Empty means all symbols.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Optional side filter.

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Max number of orders to return (1-1000, default 100).

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, sub-account scope, filters, and sort
 order.

fields.name: include_attached_risk
fields.doc: Include attached-risk policy details in each order (defaults to false when unset).

fields.name: include_attached_risk_state
fields.doc: Include attached-risk state details in each order (defaults to false when unset).

types.name: orders.v1.GetOpenOrdersResponse
types.doc: GetOpenOrdersResponse returns open orders and an optional next-page cursor.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: Open orders ordered newest-first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

fields.name: side

fields.name: status

fields.name: start_ts_ns

fields.name: end_ts_ns

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Max number of orders to return (1-1000, default 100).

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, sub-account scope, filters, time range,
 and sort order.

fields.name: include_attached_risk
fields.doc: Include attached-risk policy details in each order (defaults to false when unset).

fields.name: include_attached_risk_state

types.name: orders.v1.GetOrderHistoryResponse
types.doc: GetOrderHistoryResponse returns historical orders and an optional next-page cursor.

fields.name: orders
fields.doc: Historical orders ordered newest-first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: orders.v1.GetOrderRequest
types.doc: GetOrderRequest retrieves a single order and related execution context.

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Public order ID (base58-encoded fixed64 on REST).

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID. When provided, server resolves latest matching order for the account.

fields.name: include_attached_risk
fields.doc: Include attached-risk policy details in response.order (defaults to false when unset).

fields.name: include_attached_risk_state
fields.doc: Include attached-risk state details in response.order (defaults to false when unset).

types.name: orders.v1.GetOrderResponse
types.doc: GetOrderResponse returns the order plus related trades and transfer legs.

fields.name: order
fields.doc: Requested order, if found.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: User trade fills for the order, ordered newest-first.

fields.name: transfers
fields.doc: Transfer legs linked to the order's matches, ordered newest-first.

types.name: orders.v1.GetUserTradesRequest
types.doc: GetUserTradesRequest lists trade fills for an account.

cel.message: start_ts_ns must be <= end_ts_ns when both are set

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Optional filter by symbol_id.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Optional side filter.

fields.name: start_ts_ns
fields.doc: Inclusive start of the time range, in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: end_ts_ns
fields.doc: Inclusive end of the time range, in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: limit
fields.doc: Max number of trades to return (1-1000, default 100).

fields.name: page_token
fields.doc:
Opaque keyset cursor from a previous response. The cursor is exclusive and
 bound to the authenticated account, sub-account scope, filters, time range,
 and sort order.

types.name: orders.v1.GetUserTradesResponse
types.doc: GetUserTradesResponse returns user trade fills and an optional next-page cursor.

fields.name: trades
fields.doc: Trades ordered newest-first.

fields.name: next_page_token
fields.doc: Opaque cursor for the next page. Empty when no more results exist.

types.name: orders.v1.ModifyActionTaken
types.doc: ModifyActionTaken describes what action was applied for a modify request.

values.name: AMENDED
values.doc: Existing order was amended in place.

values.name: REPLACED
values.doc: Existing order was canceled and replaced with a new order.

types.name: orders.v1.ModifyBehavior
types.doc:
ModifyBehavior controls how ModifyOrder should handle amend-vs-replace paths.
 MODIFY_BEHAVIOR_UNSPECIFIED is treated as AMEND_OR_REPLACE by server logic.

values.name: AMEND_OR_REPLACE
values.doc: Try in-place amend first; if patch cannot be amended, fall back to replace.

values.name: AMEND_ONLY
values.doc: In-place amend only; reject if patch requires replace semantics.

values.name: REPLACE_ONLY
values.doc: Always attempt replace semantics.

types.name: orders.v1.ModifyOrderRequest
types.doc: ModifyOrderRequest updates an existing order using policy-driven amend/replace behavior.

cel.message: at least one of new_price_ticks, new_qty_scaled, or new_attached_risk must be set

fields.name: subaccount_id
fields.doc: Target sub-account numeric ID. When omitted, uses caller's root account.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order ID as fixed64.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client order ID to resolve within the caller account.

fields.name: request_id
fields.doc: Idempotency key (required).

fields.name: new_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Patch fields (presence-based).
 New limit price in ticks. Required for price changes.

fields.name: new_qty_scaled
fields.doc: Target total quantity after modify/replace.

fields.name: new_attached_risk
fields.doc: Replacement attached-risk policy for the order.

fields.name: behavior
fields.doc:
Modify behavior policy.
 MODIFY_BEHAVIOR_UNSPECIFIED is treated as AMEND_OR_REPLACE.

fields.name: new_client_order_id
fields.doc: Optional new client order id when replace path is taken.

types.name: orders.v1.ModifyOrderResponse
types.doc: ModifyOrderResponse returns deterministic modify outcome.

fields.name: action_taken
fields.doc: Action applied; unspecified when rejected.

fields.name: old_order_id
fields.doc: Original order ID that was amended or replaced.

fields.name: final_order_id
fields.doc: Final active order ID; same as old_order_id for amendments.

fields.name: code
fields.doc: Error code if rejected.

fields.name: take_profit_trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger IDs for updated attached risk controls (when applicable).

fields.name: ts
fields.doc: Server timestamp.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Server timestamp as epoch nanoseconds (for bots).

types.name: orders.v1.Order
types.doc: Order is the Connect-facing order view with compact binary fields.

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Public order identifier as fixed64.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Trading symbol numeric identifier.

fields.name: client_order_id
fields.doc: Client-provided id for idempotency/correlation (may be empty).

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Order side.

fields.name: status
fields.doc: Current order lifecycle status.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type.

fields.name: tif
fields.doc: Time-in-force policy.

fields.name: stp_mode
fields.doc: Self-trade prevention mode.

fields.name: fee_source
fields.doc: Fee source used for buy fills.

fields.name: post_only
fields.doc: True if the order was submitted as post-only (maker-only).

fields.name: orig_qty
fields.doc: Original order quantity (scaled base units).

fields.name: cum_qty
fields.doc: Cumulative filled quantity (scaled base units).

fields.name: leaves_qty
fields.doc: Remaining working quantity (scaled base units). Zero for terminal orders.

fields.name: avg_px_ticks
fields.doc: Average fill price in ticks (0 if no fills).

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Limit price in ticks (0 for MARKET).

fields.name: created_ts_ns
fields.doc: Creation timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: terminal_ts_ns
fields.doc: Terminal timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC). Zero for open orders.

fields.name: terminal_reason_code
fields.doc: Terminal reason code for canceled/rejected orders. Zero for non-terminal orders.

fields.name: terminal_reason
fields.doc:
Stable string for terminal_reason_code (e.g. "POST_ONLY_CROSS", "USER_REQUEST").
 Empty for non-terminal orders.

fields.name: attached_risk
fields.doc:
Attached risk controls + runtime state on the parent order.
 Empty when no attached risk exists.

fields.name: origin
fields.doc: Runtime lineage metadata (why the order exists and what generated it).

fields.name: market_client_ref_price_ticks
fields.doc: Optional client-side reference price used for MARKET slippage protection.

fields.name: market_max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Optional MARKET max slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: market_max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Optional MARKET max slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

types.name: orders.v1.OrderOrigin
types.doc:
OrderOrigin explains why an order exists and where it came from.

 Population rules:
 - direct/manual orders: scope=DIRECT; trigger fields unset/unspecified.
 - attached children: scope=ATTACHED_RISK; parent_order_id is set.
 - standalone trigger children: scope=STANDALONE_TRIGGER.
 - child_seq is set for multi-child strategies (for example TWAP/LADDER).

fields.name: scope
fields.doc: Broad class describing how the order was created.

fields.name: trigger_type
fields.doc: Trigger strategy that created this order, or unspecified for direct orders.

fields.name: trigger_id
fields.doc: Trigger identifier when the order was created by a trigger.

fields.name: parent_order_id
fields.doc: Parent order ID for attached-risk child orders.

fields.name: child_seq
fields.doc: Child sequence number for multi-child trigger strategies. Zero when not applicable.

types.name: orders.v1.OrderOriginScope
types.doc: OrderOriginScope captures broad origin classes for an order.

values.name: DIRECT
values.doc: User/manual order (non-trigger path).

values.name: ATTACHED_RISK
values.doc: Child generated by attached TP/SL/Trailing risk on a parent order.

values.name: STANDALONE_TRIGGER
values.doc: Child generated by a standalone trigger (STOP/TWAP/LADDER...).

values.name: SYSTEM
values.doc: Internal/system automation (for example liquidation/ops actions).

types.name: orders.v1.OrderStatus
types.doc: OrderStatus is specific to the read API (write API uses simple "accepted" status string).

values.name: PENDING
values.doc:
Accepted by the admission layer and submitted for execution, but not yet
 confirmed as working.

values.name: PENDING_CANCEL
values.doc: Cancel requested; may still be working until cancel is confirmed.

values.name: WORKING
values.doc: Accepted and actively working (resting and/or matching).

values.name: FILLED
values.doc: Fully filled (no remaining quantity).

values.name: CANCELED
values.doc: Canceled and no longer working.

values.name: REJECTED
values.doc: Rejected and never entered the working state.

types.name: orders.v1.OrderTransfer
types.doc: OrderTransfer is the Connect-facing minimal per-leg transfer view.

fields.name: match_id
fields.doc: Match identifier that linked this transfer to an execution.

fields.name: asset_id
fields.doc: Asset identifier for the transferred asset.

fields.name: amount_hi
fields.doc: Transfer amount, high 64 bits of an unsigned 128-bit integer.

fields.name: amount_lo
fields.doc: Transfer amount, low 64 bits of an unsigned 128-bit integer.

fields.name: is_debit
fields.doc: True when the transfer debits the account; false when it credits the account.

fields.name: transfer_code
fields.doc: Product reason for this transfer leg.

fields.name: account_code
fields.doc: Account bucket affected by this transfer leg.

fields.name: timestamp
fields.doc: Transfer timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch (UTC).

fields.name: tx_id
fields.doc: Transfer transaction identifier.

types.name: orders.v1.OrderTriggerType
types.doc: OrderTriggerType captures the trigger strategy that generated the order.

values.name: STOP_LOSS
values.doc: Order was generated by a stop-loss trigger.

values.name: TAKE_PROFIT
values.doc: Order was generated by a take-profit trigger.

values.name: TRAILING_STOP
values.doc: Order was generated by a trailing-stop trigger.

values.name: TWAP
values.doc: Order was generated by a time-weighted execution trigger.

values.name: LADDER
values.doc: Order was generated by a ladder execution trigger.

values.name: LIMIT
values.doc: Limit order with an explicit price.

values.name: MARKET
values.doc: Market order executed against available liquidity.

types.name: orders.v1.RiskPolicy
types.doc:
RiskPolicy defines optional risk controls (TP/SL/TrailingStop) attached to an
 order. These arm after the parent order fills and fire when conditions are
 met. If the parent order is canceled before any fill, attached risk controls
 are discarded.

cel.message: oco requires take_profit and exactly one stop leg (stop_loss or trailing_stop)

fields.name: take_profit
fields.doc: Optional take-profit configuration.

fields.name: stop_loss
fields.doc: Optional stop-loss configuration.

fields.name: trailing_stop
fields.doc: Optional trailing stop configuration.

fields.name: oco
fields.doc:
If true, take-profit and the configured stop leg (stop-loss or trailing-stop)
 form an OCO pair: when one fires, the other is canceled.
 Default is false (no mutual cancellation).

values.name: EXPIRE_MAKER
values.doc: Cancel the resting maker order on self-trade.

values.name: EXPIRE_TAKER
values.doc: Cancel the incoming taker order on self-trade.

values.name: EXPIRE_BOTH
values.doc: Cancel both maker and taker orders on self-trade.

values.name: BUY
values.doc: Buy base asset using quote asset.

values.name: SELL
values.doc: Sell base asset for quote asset.

types.name: orders.v1.StopLossPolicy
types.doc:
StopLossPolicy defines a stop-loss attached to an order.
 Arms after the parent order fills; fires when price crosses the threshold.

fields.name: trigger_price_ticks
fields.doc: Trigger price in ticks (6 decimals). Required.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Price source for trigger evaluation. Defaults to LAST_PRICE if unspecified.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type for the child order when triggered. Defaults to MARKET.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Limit price in ticks for LIMIT child orders. Required if order_type is
 LIMIT.

values.name: GTC
values.doc: Good-til-canceled.

values.name: IOC
values.doc: Immediate-or-cancel.

values.name: FOK
values.doc: Fill-or-kill.

types.name: orders.v1.TakeProfitPolicy
types.doc:
TakeProfitPolicy defines a take-profit attached to an order.
 Arms after the parent order fills; fires when price crosses the threshold.

fields.name: trigger_price_ticks
fields.doc: Trigger price in ticks (6 decimals). Required.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Price source for trigger evaluation. Defaults to LAST_PRICE if unspecified.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type for the child order when triggered. Defaults to MARKET.

fields.name: limit_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Limit price in ticks for LIMIT child orders. Required if order_type is
 LIMIT.

types.name: orders.v1.TrailingStopPolicy
types.doc:
TrailingStopPolicy defines a trailing stop attached to an order.
 Tracks peak (for sell) or trough (for buy) and fires when price reverses by
 the distance.

fields.name: trailing_distance_ticks
fields.doc: Trailing distance in absolute ticks.

fields.name: trailing_distance_bps
fields.doc: Trailing distance in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: max_slippage_ticks
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in absolute ticks.

fields.name: max_slippage_bps
fields.doc: Maximum allowed slippage in basis points (1 bp = 0.01%).

fields.name: activation_price_ticks
fields.doc:
Optional activation price: trailing only starts after this price is
 reached. If omitted, trailing starts immediately after the parent order
 fills.

fields.name: trigger_price_source
fields.doc: Price source for trigger evaluation. Defaults to LAST_PRICE if unspecified.

fields.name: order_type
fields.doc: Order type for the child order when triggered. Defaults to MARKET.

types.name: orders.v1.TriggerDirection
types.doc:
TriggerDirection defines whether the trigger fires when price goes above or
 below threshold.

values.name: ABOVE
values.doc:
Fire when price >= trigger_price (e.g., take-profit for long, stop-loss for
 short).

values.name: BELOW
values.doc:
Fire when price <= trigger_price (e.g., stop-loss for long, take-profit for
 short).

types.name: orders.v1.TriggerPriceSource
types.doc:
TriggerPriceSource defines which price feed to use for trigger evaluation.
 v1 supports LAST_PRICE only; INDEX_PRICE and MARK_PRICE are reserved for
 future.

values.name: LAST_PRICE
values.doc: Last traded price (default for spot).

values.name: INDEX_PRICE
values.doc: Index price aggregated from external exchanges (future).

values.name: MARK_PRICE
values.doc: Mark price for perpetuals (future).

types.name: orders.v1.UserTrade
types.doc: UserTrade is the Connect-facing per-user trade fill view.

fields.name: symbol_id
fields.doc: Trading symbol numeric identifier.

fields.name: match_id
fields.doc: Match identifier (monotonic per symbol).

fields.name: order_id
fields.doc: Order identifier as fixed64.

fields.name: side
fields.doc: Fill side.

fields.name: is_maker
fields.doc: True if this fill was maker-side.

fields.name: price_ticks
fields.doc: Execution price in ticks.

fields.name: qty_scaled
fields.doc: Executed quantity in scaled base units.

fields.name: fee_scaled
fields.doc: Fee amount in scaled units.

fields.name: fee_source
fields.doc: Fee source charged for this fill.

fields.name: referral_share_scaled
fields.doc: Referral share amount in scaled units.

fields.name: ts_ns
fields.doc: Execution timestamp in nanoseconds since epoch.
